title: Gaussian measure isometry invariance
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $Q$ be a linear isometry from Euclidean $n$-space to itself. The pushforward of standard Gaussian product measure, viewed as a measure on Euclidean $n$-space, under $Q$ is that same measure.
hypotheses_covered: $Q$ is a linear isometric equivalence of Euclidean $n$-space
